notes_for_editor: Only source found is the tnlandforms.us Georgia list (gatowers.html), stamped March 2016. The entry has a BLL number followed by a question mark; the page does not explain the mark, so the story reports it without interpreting it. Searched: the cached NHLR Georgia index (no Clito tower page), the firetower.org Georgia index (no match), the easternuslookouts Georgia list (no Clito entry), and two web searches. The searches found a 1980 archaeological survey for a proposed Clito substation off Middle Ground Road near Statesboro, which is electrical infrastructure, not a tower, and a 2026 Bulloch County wildfire news cluster that does not mention a lookout. Nothing confirms a tower's build, use, removal or current state. The story is below the 120-word floor because the evidence supports so little. Do not add visit or access claims without a managing-agency source.
